Article.ArticleTitle: Contextual Bandits for Just-in-Time Mental Health Interventions

Abstract.AbstractText: We conducted a randomized controlled trial of a contextual bandit for mental health intervention timing with N=240 participants.
The adaptive intervention improved adherence compared with fixed timing.

Article.ArticleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Agents for Psychotherapy: A Systematic Review

Abstract.AbstractText: We conducted a systematic review of conversational agent systems for psychotherapy and mental health care. We compare human evaluation and clinician validation methods. The review identifies inconsistent safety reporting.

Article.ArticleTitle: Offline Reinforcement Learning for Personalized Anxiety Interventions

Abstract.AbstractText: We evaluate offline reinforcement learning on a retrospective clinical dataset from 180 patients with anxiety. The method uses longitudinal histories to personalize intervention choices. Results outperform a supervised baseline in off-policy evaluation.
